title: Safety Vest and Helmet Detection
description: Detect safety vests and hard hats in an image.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model to identify the presence of safety vests and hard hats, including workers without them, in an image/video. This variant re-sources its data from combined-PPE construction datasets where helmet and vest presence/absence are labeled together in the same frame, avoiding the missing-label conflict of merging single-purpose (vest-only / helmet-only) datasets. This model is suitable for construction site safety and workplace PPE compliance monitoring applications.
